question: Across the frozen RA01 Reference domain, did every positive-root-fraction node remain in the exact full-potential Feddes drought regime, or did any node enter alpha<1 so that the tiny route-to-route uptake differences could contain a physical threshold/regime component?

instrumentation.scope: output-only diagnostics evaluated inside the existing committed-state root process before each hydraulic transaction
per_history_or_segment: minimum pressure_head minus diagnostics.critical_pressure_head over rooted nodes
instrumentation.positive_root_fraction_note: The frozen SHALLOW and UNIFORM cumulative-root profiles give strictly positive increments on every rooted node.

integrity_rules.expected_root_node_evaluations: rooted_nodes multiplied by executed hydraulic transactions; segmented R2048_T32 counts must sum over all four frozen segments

classifications.NODE_LEVEL_FULL_POTENTIAL_IDENTITY: For every material, history, route and segment: stressed_node_evaluations=0, minimum drought_reduction_factor is exactly 1.0, minimum h-h3 is nonnegative, and expected evaluation counts close exactly.
classifications.NODE_LEVEL_PHYSICAL_STRESS_PRESENT: Any rooted node on any frozen RA01 trajectory has drought_reduction_factor < 1.0 or h-h3 < 0.
classifications.DIAGNOSTIC_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: Expected node-evaluation counts do not close or required diagnostic values are missing/nonfinite.

decision_rule.if_NODE_LEVEL_FULL_POTENTIAL_IDENTITY: D1 numerical-floor interpretation is node-level supported. This does not reclassify RA01 as qualified, but it may release the already-preregistered RA02 stress-active Reference-only execution from governance hold.
decision_rule.if_NODE_LEVEL_PHYSICAL_STRESS_PRESENT: Keep RA02 execution on hold. Do not reinterpret the RA01 root-uptake uncertainty failure as purely numerical.
decision_rule.if_DIAGNOSTIC_INTEGRITY_FAILURE: Technical repair only; no scientific decision.
